amendment_2026_08_14_r5_signoff.R14_stability_definition: In status_1, 'stable across every decision-relevant reading' MEANS the three preceding conjuncts hold in ALL cells of the decision-relevant grid, and 'stable between poolings' MEANS those three conjuncts hold under pooling (a) as well as (b). In status_3, 'the C1a count varies by <= 20% relative' MEANS (max - min) / max of the pooled primary-scope C1a count over the grid.
amendment_2026_08_14_r5_signoff.R12_r4_ADDENDUM_direction_of_r4s_own_rep: r3's directions were itemised in R12; r4's own were NOT, which is exactly the failure mode R12 was written to end. (f) R7's added S2 level CANNOT make status_1 or status_3 easier and in fact makes BOTH HARDER — status_1 requires its conjuncts under EVERY reading, so a new cell adds a conjunct; status_3 requires <= 20% relative C1a variation across EVERY reading, and a 0.25x-tol cell widens that span sharply. R7 makes status_4 EASIER, because 'reading_label not constant' is easier over a larger, more heterogeneous grid. R7 achieves its stated purpose for the CLASS C1a at the 0.25x cell ONLY, NOT for the adequacy STATUS. NET r4 DIRECTION BEFORE R15: statuses 1, 2 and 3 all harder, status 4 easier. ONLY the maximal-bridged-run equality is a genuine check on the recomputed association, and r4 overstated the pair by exactly the amount r4 criticised r3 for.

R15_OWNER_robustness_grade_replaces_unan.defect: the r4 sign-off established that with all-readings quantifiers over a grid DELIBERATELY WIDENED to include extreme readings (0.25x and 2x tol; 16 px and 256 px eligibility), statuses 1 and 3 are very likely structurally unreachable and 'reading_label not constant' is near-guaranteed. The design would then return status_4 BY CONSTRUCTION rather than by evidence — an uninformative verdict wearing the costume of a measurement finding. Unanimity across deliberately extreme readings is not a robustness criterion; it is a guarantee of non-unanimity.
R15_OWNER_robustness_grade_replaces_unan.repair: the PRIMARY STATUS is determined at the PRIMARY READING under binding pooling (b). The grid determines a ROBUSTNESS GRADE reported alongside it: UNANIMOUS (reading_label constant over all cells), ROBUST (reading_label agrees with the primary reading in >= robustness_supermajority of cells), FRAGILE (otherwise). A FRAGILE grade FORCES status_4 regardless of the primary reading's label. A UNANIMOUS or ROBUST grade reports the primary reading's status WITH the grade attached. status_1's and status_3's all-readings conjuncts are correspondingly REPLACED by the grade.
R15_OWNER_robustness_grade_replaces_unan.margin_disclosure: 2/3 is a DISCLOSED DESIGN MARGIN, not a derivation.
R15_OWNER_robustness_grade_replaces_unan.DISCLOSED_DIRECTION: this makes status_4 LESS likely and statuses 1, 2 and 3 MORE likely. It was made PRE-DATA, after a fresh reviewer predicted status_4-by-construction, and BEFORE any classification statistic existed. It is the only change in this program's history that relaxes a decisive verdict, and it is recorded as such. The FULL per-cell reading_label table is a required output precisely so that any reader may apply the strict unanimity rule instead and see whether it changes the answer; if it does, that fact is reported in the result.
R15_OWNER_robustness_grade_replaces_unan.why_this_is_not_steering: the author has no classification statistic and therefore cannot know which status the primary reading yields. What is known is only that the r4 rule yields status_4 almost regardless of the data, which is the defect being repaired.

scientific_question: Does the frozen true-absence statistic distinguish (a) genuine disappearance of an identity's foreground component from every applicable camera, from (b) continued component presence with failed or missing tracks, (c) reports below the visibility threshold, (d) association failure, (e) undefined consensus, (f) projection/calibration/substrate failure, and (g) genuinely unidentifiable cases? The frozen census TEXT defines true absence through disappearance of the relevant foreground component; the IMPLEMENTATION operationally treats a missing qualifying report on an eligible component as absence. These coincide when tracking works and may diverge when it fails. Treated here as a HYPOTHESIS, not an established defect.

evidence_boundary.secondary_scope: the true_absence_candidate windows of the three cycle-3 FULL-window sequences (writing_2 corrected, pour_tea, tambourine), in a separately labelled panel. DISCLOSED (N5): this panel is a SUPERSET of the corresponding primary rows, not an independent sample; it reports NO coverage-derived statistic of any kind.
evidence_boundary.g_oa_is_not_reopened: The cycle-3 G-OA verdict is a valid FAIL whose sole violation is pour_tea's per-sequence unscreened-half track COVERAGE 0.3748 < 0.5 — a component-coverage ratio, computed entirely within a verified-clean conversion. This diagnostic classifies absence WINDOWS and cannot arithmetically alter a component-coverage ratio. No outcome here can convert that FAIL into a PASS, and this diagnostic must never be cited as reopening it.
evidence_boundary.cannot_answer: This diagnostic classifies windows the instrument DID score. It cannot discover absences the instrument failed to score (false negatives), cannot establish the true physical event rate, and cannot by itself establish that any classified window contains a genuine identity-preserving return.
evidence_boundary.instrument_comparability: verified by the design author and independently re-verified by the hostile reviewer: scripts/build_m1_census.py changed between the screening commit 1d8f3b0 and the corrected-substrate commit 79ae5b7 by exactly one purely ADDITIVE hunk (per-half by_half coverage tallies at 644251f, 16 insertions / 1 deletion, docstring + tallies only); build_association, components_total, components_covered, occlusion_events and true_absence_and_returns are byte-identical. scripts/build_elgs_tracks.py is unchanged since 49b5e5e, which precedes every screening run.
evidence_boundary.named_artifacts: every consumed artifact is named by Apollo path and its sha256 recorded in the output at execution: converted scene (transforms_train.json + masks/), sealed tracks artifact (tracks.json + MANIFEST.json), sealed census (census.json), conversion provenance.

units.identity: a seed_id of the frozen tracks artifact. CRITICAL: a seed is a visual-hull SURFACE VOXEL sampled at the query frame, NOT a physical object. Many seeds may lie on one object; ONE SEED MAY LIE ON NO PERSISTENT OBJECT AT ALL (a silhouette-intersection phantom). Class C1c exists precisely to catch that case.
units.camera: a training camera id (ids congruent 0 mod 4 are held out and never appear).
units.frame: an integer frame index inside the sequence's realized census window.
units.component: an 8-connected foreground component of the mask binarized at > 127, of area >= component_min_px (the frozen census eligibility rule).
units.window_record: one true_absence_candidate record emitted by the frozen census, identified by (sequence, seed_id, first_frame).
units.temporal_unit_W: the frame. Window-level statistics aggregate over the ABSENT-FRAME SET W(record) = { t in [first_frame, last_frame] : NO camera c in S carries report status ASSOCIATED at (c,t) }. Frames of the closed interval that DO carry an association in some c in S are BRIDGED frames — they enter the census window through the frozen flicker_rule (build_m1_census: window.extend(reappearance_run)) and their presence is EXPECTED, not an inconsistency. Bridged frames are EXCLUDED from every fraction denominator and tallied per window as bridged_associated_frames. Every occurrence of 'window frames' below means W(record).

applicable_camera_set.primary: S = the record's containing_cameras exactly as the frozen census emitted it (fixed at event start per frozen reading R3). NEVER recomputed for the primary classification.
applicable_camera_set.queried_subset: S_q = { c in S : the sealed tracks artifact contains a track row for (seed_id, c) }. Cameras in S \ S_q were never queried for this seed (the seed was not mask-positive there at the query frame) and can NEVER associate; they always vote for absence.
applicable_camera_set.sensitivity_S1_declared_irrelevant: recomputing frustum containment per frame is a PROVABLE NO-OP: P is fixed by anchor.definition and the rig is static (asserted by _static_rig_matrix, codified as frozen reading R12). Reported as descriptive only; it cannot move any status.

anchor.definition: P = the record's ltp (last triangulated consensus position), frozen; ltp_frame is its source frame.
anchor.projection: exactly as build_m1_census.frustum_contains: cam = R P + t; require z > 0; uv = K cam; x = uv0/uv2, y = uv1/uv2; bounds [0, W-1] x [0, H-1] on continuous coordinates. The strict-occupancy pixel is the round-half-up integer pixel (frozen reading R8).
anchor.tolerance: tol_c = r_site_census * fl_x_c / z_c — the projected radius of the 3-D r_site ball, the identical construction the frozen R2-prime return predicate uses. r_site_census is READ from the sequence's own sealed census constants.r_site_census; no free pixel constant is introduced.
anchor.anchor_provenance_LIMIT_r3: P is the census's consensus triangulation of in-domain v >= 0.5 reports, and build_elgs_tracks.build_artifact populates that triangulation input WITHOUT any mask-eligibility test — a report that is in-domain and visible but lands on BACKGROUND (the OFF_COMPONENT mode under test) still feeds it. Moreover last_defined_consensus is evaluated at the window's first absent frame, so ltp_frame MAY EQUAL first_frame. Therefore D1 is NOT independent of the tracker in the failure mode under test: under tracker drift, P can be the triangulation of the very reports whose failure defines the window. No status of this diagnostic may be stated as tracker adequacy or as instrument adequacy. This limit is the reason C1 is split and anchor-quality outputs are mandatory.

per_pair_tests.T1_strict_anchor_occupancy: an ELIGIBLE component contains the round-half-up projected pixel of P in camera c at frame t.
per_pair_tests.T2_ball_anchor_occupancy: some ELIGIBLE component has a pixel within Euclidean 2-D distance tol_c of the CONTINUOUS projected pixel (inclusive <=). MANDATED FORM (N3): test a disc of radius ceil(tol_c) around the projected pixel for membership in any eligible label. No full-image distance transform is required.
per_pair_tests.T2b_subthreshold_anchor_occupancy: some connected foreground component of ANY area (component_min_px filter NOT applied) has a pixel within tol_c of the continuous projection. Distinguishes 'nothing is there' from 'something too small to be eligible is there'.
per_pair_tests.T3_any_foreground: camera c at frame t has >= 1 eligible component anywhere in its mask.
per_pair_tests.R_report_status: exactly one of: NEVER_QUERIED (no track row exists for this (seed_id, camera_id) at all), MISS_TOKEN (a track row exists and this frame's report is a miss token), OUT_OF_DOMAIN (non-miss but the round-half-up pixel falls outside bounds — ASSERTED EMPTY for artifacts built at 49b5e5e per N1; tallied, never fatal), LOW_VISIBILITY (in-domain, v < 0.5), OFF_COMPONENT (in-domain, v >= 0.5, pixel on background or an INELIGIBLE component), ASSOCIATED (in-domain, v >= 0.5, pixel in an eligible component).
per_pair_tests.ASSOCIATED_handling_r4: ASSOCIATED is EXPECTED at bridged frames (which is why they are excluded from W) and, under sensitivity reading S5 only, at ordinary frames (R9 corrects r3's erroneous reference to S1, which is a provable no-op). It is TALLIED, NEVER FATAL. R4 binds: W is computed once under the PRIMARY reading and held fixed, so an S5-induced ASSOCIATED at t in W is tallied as reading_induced_associated and excluded from BOTH numerator and denominator of step 2's report-status fraction.
per_pair_tests.operative_fail_closed_guard_R6: the r3 conditions (W empty; min W != first_frame; max W != last_frame) are PROVABLY UNREACHABLE and are retained only as TAUTOLOGY CHECKS whose passing is not evidence. The OPERATIVE guard is: for every record, |W(record)| + bridged_associated_frames == record.n_frames, AND the number of MAXIMAL RUNS of bridged frames inside [first_frame, last_frame] == record.bridged_interruptions. Either mismatch fails the SEQUENCE closed. This is the only check that the diagnostic reproduces the sealed census's own association.
per_pair_tests.R_grouping_for_the_decision_list: MISS_TOKEN and OUT_OF_DOMAIN form the 'tracker was asked and did not place the identity here' group; LOW_VISIBILITY and OFF_COMPONENT form the 'tracker placed it but the report did not qualify' group. NEVER_QUERIED belongs to NEITHER group and NEVER contributes to C2 — the tracker was never asked.

substrate_check.rule: for every training camera, decode the actual pixel dimensions of one mask and one undistorted frame and compare against that camera's declared (w,h) in transforms_train.json. Any mismatch in any camera fails the sequence closed.
substrate_check.also_recorded: archive_selection.train.archive_path from the conversion provenance for every sequence in scope.

identity_evidence.problem_statement: T1/T2/T2b establish that FOREGROUND covers the frozen anchor. They do NOT establish that the covering component IS the identity whose absence was scored. C2, C3 and C5 are ALL equally non-identifiable about identity; they differ only in the SUSTAINEDNESS and MULTI-VIEW CONSISTENCY of anchor occupancy, which is an occupancy property, not an identifiability property. This diagnostic never claims 'the identity was present'.
identity_evidence.what_D1_does_establish: if foreground demonstrably and multi-view-consistently occupies the anchor, then the literal frozen predicate ('the object's fg-mask component vanishes from ALL cameras whose frustum contains its last triangulated position') is not established — WHATEVER the identity is. That is a statement about the instrument's self-consistency, subject to the anchor_provenance_LIMIT_r3 above.

secondary_instrument_D2_deterministic_co.construction: for each c in S_q, let t0 be the last frame strictly before first_frame at which the identity was ASSOCIATED in c. Let X0 be that eligible component. Propagate: X_{t+1} = the eligible component in frame t+1 maximising IoU against the pixel set of X_t, accepted iff IoU >= lineage_iou_min; else the lineage ENDS. Record per camera the fraction of W(record) survived, plus merge and split events.
secondary_instrument_D2_deterministic_co.independence_disclosure: the lineage ENTRY uses a tracker SUCCESS; propagation thereafter is purely mask-geometric. This is NOT full independence and is not claimed as such: a tracker already mis-associated before the window propagates its error into D2. Corroboration: X0 is compared against the anchor projection at t0 and agreement recorded as entry_corroborated.
secondary_instrument_D2_deterministic_co.role: CORROBORATIVE ONLY. Never changes an assigned class. Its agreement rate with the assigned class is published. Consequently sensitivity axis S4 cannot move any status and is declared decision-irrelevant by construction.

identity_evidence.what_is_refused: correspondence will NOT be manufactured by re-running, re-querying or re-seeding the tracker whose failure is under test. This diagnostic performs NO new tracking.

mandatory_successor_B8_FROZEN_R10.class: the PRIMARY-reading class at the TERMINAL level, in this fixed order: C1a, C1b, C1c, C2, C3, C5_NON_IDENTIFIABLE, C5_STRUCTURALLY_SILENT, C5_NO_SUSTAINED_ANCHOR_OCCUPANCY.
mandatory_successor_B8_FROZEN_R10.terciles: terciles of anchor_staleness computed on the POOLED primary-scope distribution, with boundaries by NEAREST-RANK on the sorted values (the ceil(n/3)-th and ceil(2n/3)-th, NO interpolation); ties assigned to the LOWER tercile. Nearest-rank is required because anchor_staleness = first_frame - ltp_frame is a small non-negative integer with heavy ties at 0 (ltp_frame may equal first_frame), so an interpolated percentile would place different windows in different strata and yield a different sample.
mandatory_successor_B8_FROZEN_R10.strata_order: (sequence ascending, class in the fixed order above, tercile ascending).
mandatory_successor_B8_FROZEN_R10.within_stratum_order: records ordered by (sequence, seed_id, first_frame), then permuted by numpy.random.default_rng(20260814).permutation. The RNG is constructed FRESH PER STRATUM (a new default_rng(20260814) for each stratum), not shared across strata.
mandatory_successor_B8_FROZEN_R10.allocation: round-robin, one window per non-empty stratum per round, WITHOUT replacement, continuing until at least 60 have been drawn AND every non-empty stratum has been visited at least once.
mandatory_successor_B8_FROZEN_R10.emitted_fields: sequence, seed_id, first_frame, last_frame, |W|, bridged_associated_frames, class, anchor_staleness, containing_cameras, ltp, ltp_frame.
mandatory_successor_B8_FROZEN_R10.supersession_DISCLOSED: this SUPERSEDES prereg_m1_census_v1.json audit_protocol.sample (strata 'sequence x duration tercile', seed 20260811) FOR THIS SAMPLE ONLY. The r3 claim that the frozen protocol was 'unchanged' was FALSE and is withdrawn. UNCHANGED and still binding: auditors (two independent fresh-context audits, blinded to census outputs, tracks, and each other), camera_rule (the 3 training cameras of maximal pairwise angular separation, ties by ascending id), frames_per_camera (5), verdict (confirmed only if BOTH audits agree ABSENT; disagreement counts as unconfirmed), and estimate (one-sided lower Clopper-Pearson 90% bound on the confirmed proportion, multiplied by the total candidate count).
mandatory_successor_B8_FROZEN_R10.bridged_frame_bias_DISCLOSED: audit_protocol.frame_stride is uniform over the CENSUS window [first_frame, last_frame], which INCLUDES bridged frames at which the identity is associated by construction. A sampled bridged frame can never yield an ABSENT-ABSENT confirmation, so the audit's confirmation rate is biased DOWNWARD on bridged windows (85 of 109 poker windows carry at least one). Sampled frames landing on a bridged frame are recorded as bridged_sampled_frame and reported. The frozen verdict rule is NOT changed.
mandatory_successor_B8_FROZEN_R10.scope: NO statement about whether the frozen true-absence statistic measures PHYSICAL absence may be recorded before that audit returns. EMITTING the sample is in scope for this phase; RUNNING the audit is NOT.

ordered_decision_list: step 0: if the sequence fails substrate_check -> C4_SUBSTRATE_OR_PROJECTION. (TAUTOLOGY CHECK per N2, WIDENED at r4 per R9: BOTH limbs are unreachable. substrate_check.rule and stopping_conditions each fail the SEQUENCE closed on any mismatch, so C4 can never be assigned to a WINDOW and is asserted EMPTY; and the secondary limb is unreachable whenever substrate_check passes, because S was built by frustum_contains on the declared bounds and declared == decoded is exactly what substrate_check verifies. Retained; its passing is NOT evidence. A non-empty C4 count fails the run closed as an implementation inconsistency.)

step 1: else if T2(c,t) is False for every c in S and every t in W(record): if T2b is ALSO False for every such pair AND ltp_on_eligible_component >= 0.5 -> C1a_GENUINE_ABSENCE_CORROBORATED; else if T2b holds anywhere -> C1b_SUBTHRESHOLD_FOREGROUND_ONLY; else -> C1c_ANCHOR_UNSUPPORTED

step 2: else let A_t = { c in S : T1(c,t) }; frame t is MULTI-VIEW-CONFIRMED iff |A_t| >= min_occupancy_cameras AND A_t contains a camera pair whose optical-axis angular separation is >= the sequence's frozen angular floor. Let M = the set of multi-view-confirmed frames of W(record). If |M| / |W(record)| >= occupancy_frame_fraction_min: let A_q_star = { c in S_q : c in A_t for some t in M }; if A_q_star is EMPTY -> C5_NON_IDENTIFIABLE, additionally tallied as C5_STRUCTURALLY_SILENT. Otherwise let c* be the member of A_q_star maximising its count of frames in M with T1(c*,t) (ties by lowest camera id); over those frames, if the fraction with status in {MISS_TOKEN, OUT_OF_DOMAIN} >= report_majority_fraction -> C2_TRACK_OR_REPORT_LOSS; else -> C3_VISIBILITY_OR_ASSOCIATION_FAILURE

step 3: else -> C5_NO_SUSTAINED_ANCHOR_OCCUPANCY (foreground lies within the anchor ball somewhere in W(record) but multi-view-consistent sustained occupancy AT the anchor is not established; the evidence cannot separate a slightly-moved identity, a different nearby object, and a genuine departure whose vacated site is incidentally or physically covered)
step 4: TAUTOLOGY CHECK (N2): C6_OTHER is unreachable because steps 0-3 already total. Asserted EMPTY; a non-empty C6 fails the run closed.
classification.totality: steps 0-4 partition every scored window exactly once.
classification.binding: C1 in EVERY decision rule below means C1a ALONE. C1b and C1c are reported separately and NEVER count toward adequacy. C5 aggregates C5_NON_IDENTIFIABLE, C5_STRUCTURALLY_SILENT and C5_NO_SUSTAINED_ANCHOR_OCCUPANCY, each also reported separately.
classification.class_semantics_caveat: C2/C3 assert that an eligible foreground component sustained multi-view-consistent occupancy of the frozen anchor while the tracker did not qualify there. They do NOT assert the scored identity was present, and they CANNOT distinguish 'the component is still there' from 'the manipulating hand now occupies the vacated site'. C1a asserts that no foreground of any size occupied the anchor ball and that the anchor itself sat on foreground at ltp_frame; it corroborates but does not prove genuine physical disappearance.

sensitivity_readings.decision_relevant_grid: the FULL cross product S2 x S3 x S5 x S7 = 4 x 3 x 3 x 4 = 144 combinations (R7 added the fourth S2 level), ALL decision-relevant, ALL reported. No reading may be flagged decision-relevant or irrelevant AFTER execution.
sensitivity_readings.S2_occupancy_tolerance: varies the occupancy RADIUS in BOTH decision steps jointly; T2b's radius scales identically (R5). The (step1, step2) pairs are exactly: (0.25x-tol T2, T1) [added at r4 per R7], (T2, T1) [primary], (T2, T2), (2x-tol T2, T2).
sensitivity_readings.S7_note: reading 1 reproduces revision 1's single-camera rule so the effect of the r2 tightening on the final status is measured and published, not assumed.

declared_decision_irrelevant_by_construc.S1_camera_set: provable no-op: fixed anchor + static rig (frozen reading R12). Reported descriptively.
S4_lineage_iou: cannot move a class because D2 is corroborative-only. Reported descriptively.
S6_report_majority_fraction: only redistributes mass between C2 and C3, while every decision rule uses their SUM. Reported descriptively.

per_sequence_and_pooled: C5 total and its three sub-counts (NON_IDENTIFIABLE / STRUCTURALLY_SILENT / NO_SUSTAINED_ANCHOR_OCCUPANCY)
D2 lineage verdict distribution and its agreement rate with the assigned class
report-status cross-tabulation over all (c in S, t in W) pairs, with NEVER_QUERIED / MISS_TOKEN / OUT_OF_DOMAIN / LOW_VISIBILITY / OFF_COMPONENT reported separately
T3 any-foreground rate over the same pairs
bridged_associated_frames per window and per sequence
anchor_quality_B3: ltp_n_cam and ltp_reproj_rms from the consensus entry at ltp_frame
seed n_cam, seed reproj_rms_px, and per-(seed,camera) fb_rms_px from the sealed tracks diagnostics
ltp_on_eligible_component = fraction of c in S whose round-half-up projection of P at ltp_frame lies inside an eligible component
query_gap_B4: per window: |S|, |S_q|, and the NEVER_QUERIED share of all (c in S, t in W) pairs
per sequence: the distribution and the mean fraction of S that is structurally unable to associate
the fraction of windows for which every camera of S was queried
tolerance_B9: per sequence: the median, min and max of tol_c over c in S across all in-scope windows
the median foreground area fraction per (camera, frame)
required_outputs.stratification_N4_R4: every class count additionally stratified by (a) ABSENT-FRAME COUNT in seconds (|W|/fps: <0.125, 0.125-0.5, >0.5) and (b) END_TRUNCATED (last_frame == the realized census window's last frame). NAMING CORRECTED at r4: this is NOT a window SPAN — |W| excludes bridged frames, and the census's own duration_floor_frames = 8 binds len(window) (bridged INCLUDED, frozen reading R5), so |W| can be as low as 3. Both |W|/fps and n_frames/fps are reported so the two units are never confused. At 120 fps the frozen 8-frame floor is 67 ms, which is not a physical disappearance under any reading; that is why this stratification exists. END_TRUNCATED windows never count toward the adequacy-status numerator (they remain in the denominator — one-sided but deterministic).
required_outputs.pooling_B7_R2: every class fraction reported THREE ways: (a) pooled over the 597 windows; (b) the UNWEIGHTED MEAN over the sequences carrying >= 10 windows — THE BINDING POOLING; (c) leave-scissor-out pooled. POOLING DISAGREEMENT (any of status_1/2/3 differing in truth value between (a) and (b)) forces status_4 by the r4 precedence.
required_outputs.relationships: coverage vs EVERY absence class, reported continuously (pearson and spearman over the 20 sequences, and per-eligible-component rates), NEVER as a post-hoc coverage group
required_outputs.sensitivity_table: the class distribution and the reading_label under every one of the 144 decision-relevant combinations, plus the ROBUSTNESS GRADE (R15), plus an explicit statement of whether the STRICT UNANIMITY rule (the superseded r4 behaviour) would have produced a different primary status — and if so, which
required_outputs.audit_sample_B8: the sealed stratified >= 60-window M1-A0b sample list
required_outputs.evidence_grading: every classification carries: primary evidence cited, independence from the evaluated implementation, sensitivity to residual semantics, confidence grade, and whether it is gate-bearing (NONE are), diagnostic-only, or unresolved.

what_the_statuses_mean.scope_B8: These statuses name the MASK-OCCUPANCY CONSISTENCY question ONLY. No status is evidence about physical object presence, about tracker correctness, or about the adequacy of any frozen statistic. The physical-absence question is answerable only by the M1-A0b audit whose sample this diagnostic emits.
what_the_statuses_mean.status_1_ANCHOR_OCCUPANCY_CONSISTENT: at the PRIMARY READING (R14) under binding pooling (b): C1a >= 0.80 AND C1a >= 0.60 in every sequence carrying >= 10 windows AND (C2 + C3) <= 0.10, AND the same three conjuncts hold under pooling (a). END_TRUNCATED windows excluded from the numerator. Cross-reading behaviour is carried by the ROBUSTNESS GRADE (R15), not by an all-readings conjunct.
what_the_statuses_mean.status_2_ANCHOR_OCCUPANCY_INCONSISTENT: at the PRIMARY READING (R14) under binding pooling (b): (C2 + C3) >= 0.50, OR (C2 + C3) >= 0.50 in EACH member of the MINIMAL descending-absence-count prefix of sequences summing to >= 50% of the total. For the frozen 597-window scope that prefix is {scissor} ALONE (343/597 = 57.45%); it is NAMED HERE and FIXED, and no other grouping is admissible. The r4 cross-reading quantifier (R8) is SUPERSEDED by the ROBUSTNESS GRADE (R15), which applies symmetrically to BOTH disjuncts and to every other status — the r4 asymmetry that made the single-sequence route cheap is therefore still closed.
what_the_statuses_mean.status_3_PARTIALLY_CONFOUNDED: neither 1 nor 2 holds, AND at the PRIMARY READING under binding pooling (b): C1a >= 0.10 AND C1a >= 0.10 in the largest-supply sequence. Cross-reading stability is carried by the ROBUSTNESS GRADE (R15). The r4 '<= 20% relative variation across every reading' clause is SUPERSEDED, and its (max - min)/max definition is retained ONLY as a reported diagnostic.
what_the_statuses_mean.status_4_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: C5 >= 0.50 at the PRIMARY READING under binding pooling (b), OR the ROBUSTNESS GRADE is FRAGILE (R15), OR POOLING DISAGREEMENT holds (R2, evaluated on status_2 and status_3 only per R14_stability_definition). NO analyst discretion; the 'unless a conservative reading is defensible' clause of r1/r2 is DELETED.
what_the_statuses_mean.status_5_UNRESOLVED: none of statuses 1-4 holds. Reported as UNRESOLVED with the full class table and NO adequacy or defect language.
what_the_statuses_mean.binding_pooling_R2: every status predicate above is evaluated under pooling (b), the UNWEIGHTED MEAN over sequences carrying >= 10 windows. Poolings (a) pooled-over-597 and (c) leave-scissor-out are reported and NEVER bind. Rationale: 343/597 = 57.45% means pooling (a) is arithmetically scissor alone.
what_the_statuses_mean.precedence: if POOLING DISAGREEMENT holds -> status_4; else status_2, then status_1, then status_4, then status_3, then status_5. Exactly one primary status is reported. This replaces the r3 precedence, which contradicted required_outputs.pooling_B7.
what_the_statuses_mean.mapping_to_the_user_facing_question: status_1 -> 'current absence instrument adequate for its intended screening use' (subject to the anchor_provenance_LIMIT and the pending M1-A0b audit); status_2 -> 'material defect; a corrected or supplemental instrument must be defined'; status_3 -> 'partially confounded but a conservative screening interpretation is available'; status_4 or status_5 -> 'the required distinction is not identifiable from existing evidence'. The mapping is stated here BEFORE execution so it cannot be chosen afterwards.

what_this_diagnostic_may_not_do: it may not retroactively rescue or reopen the cycle-3 G-OA valid FAIL
it may not change the EL-GS claim scope or the 8.0 novelty rating
it may not re-score, re-run, or replace any frozen census statistic
it may not perform new tracking, new conversion, or new dataset acquisition
it may not be used to justify screening a new DiVa-360 sequence in this phase
it may not state a conclusion about PHYSICAL absence before the M1-A0b audit returns
no output of this diagnostic is gate-bearing for any EL-GS claim

execution_and_verification.compute: CPU-only. No GPU is required: no tracking, no rendering, no training. GPU execution offers no advantage.
execution_and_verification.mandated_pass_structure_N3_R9: the pass is per SEQUENCE, not per window, and camera-major then frame-major. It decodes EVERY frame of the realized census window — NOT only frames appearing in some W(record) — because ltp_on_eligible_component needs masks at ltp_frame (ltp_frame <= first_frame and it may lie outside every W) and D2 needs masks at t0 < first_frame. Connected-component labels for (c,t) are computed AT MOST ONCE and reused across every window that needs t; the three S5 area floors are applied to the SAME labelling in one pass. The per-window form (scissor: 343 windows x 26 cameras x ~50 frames ~ 4.5e5 decodes) is intractable and is NOT the specified algorithm; the per-sequence form is ~26 x 562 ~ 1.5e4 decodes, matching build_association's own loop structure. The 144 grid cells are RE-AGGREGATIONS of one cached boolean tensor, never re-passes.
execution_and_verification.cost_estimate: 12 primary-scope sequences carry >= 1 window; each requires one streaming pass over already-converted masks — the same order as the original census pass. Measured basis (owner, from the sealed censuses): the 12 in-scope sequences' original censuses total 742.8 s = 0.21 CPU-h. REVISED at r4 after the re-reviewer noted the r3 figure under-scoped D2 lineage propagation, the three full-window secondary-panel sequences, and the out-of-W decodes: estimate 1-4 CPU-hours total, parallelizable to about 15-40 minutes wall. Storage added: < 200 MB of JSON. Network: reads existing Apollo artifacts in place. No new download, no new conversion, no new tracking. Actual vs estimated is reported.
execution_and_verification.cheaper_alternatives_considered: (a) pure re-analysis of the sealed census records — REJECTED: the census records no mask state at non-associated (camera, frame) pairs, so it cannot answer the question at all; (b) stratified sampling of windows — REJECTED: adds sampling error for negligible saving given the full pass is CPU-cheap; (c) the frozen M1-A0b human audit — NOT rejected. It is the ONLY route to the physical-absence question and is now a MANDATORY SUCCESSOR whose sample this diagnostic emits. It is sequenced after, not instead of, this pass because it needs this mask evidence to stratify on.
execution_and_verification.stopping_conditions: the run stops when all primary-scope windows are classified, the secondary panel is computed, and the audit sample is emitted. It fails closed on: any substrate mismatch, any non-empty C6, any non-empty C4, ANY VIOLATION OF operative_fail_closed_guard_R6, any missing artifact, or any sha256 mismatch. (The r3/r4 'EMPTY W' and 'min/max disagree' conditions are retained only as labelled tautology checks and are NOT operative stop conditions — see R6.)
execution_and_verification.independent_verification: a fresh-context worker writes its OWN reduction from THIS FILE'S TEXT ALONE and must not read the primary diagnostic implementation, its tests, its computed outputs, or any result page until its own results are sealed.
execution_and_verification.what_agreement_means_N6: exact agreement establishes that the frozen text is MECHANICALLY EXECUTABLE and was executed as written. It is NOT evidence that the text measures the intended quantity — both implementations share the specification and would reproduce a specification-level error identically (B2 is the proof: under r1/r2 both would have aborted). The reducer MUST additionally report, in its own words, the three readings where it judged the text underdetermined.
